The Dangote group this month launched a widespread marketing campaign to attract retail investors as part of the IPO planned to raise $1.6 billion and valuing the largest refinery in Africa at $47 billion.   The ‘IPO for the people’ could boost the number of retail shareholder accounts in Nigeria fourfold.…
